content:
Maria Lopez: IncidentBot just paged me for rising 5xxs on /v2/prompt-route-experimental around 10:22 UTC. Error rate jumped ~18% in last 5m. @oncall is me.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] high_error_rate prompt-route-experimental -- threshold breach (18% 5xx) -- paging Maria Lopez & Samir Patel. Link: https://incidents.redwood.local/2781234567
Maria Lopez: I'm digging into canary rollout ID=rl-2026-04-11-1934. Deployed ~20 mins ago. Metrics show tail latency up and a subset of requests 502/504.
Samir Patel: I'm on-call secondary. Looking at k8s logs for prompt-router pods in canary pool. Jia, can you confirm runtime changes in this deploy?
Jia Chen: That rollout included the new prompt-mux endpoint + an experimental routing policy (probabilistic split). I pushed the config. No infra changes.
Ankit Rao: Rolling logs: seeing repeated OOM-ish traces in libkv-cache on a couple of canary workers, followed by connection reset to upstream model server.
Maria Lopez: OOM? Any memory pressure metric?
Samir Patel: Node metrics show a spike in RSS for canary pods right before restarts. Looks like the new request pattern increases KV cache retention.
Lina Gomez: SupportOps: We have 3 customer reports of degraded responses in last 15m (support ticket #9871, #9872, #9873). All on the new prompt path.
Maria Lopez: This is impacting real traffic. Need emergency safety net: flip the feature flag to cut traffic off the experimental endpoint. DeployBot, can you run the FF kill?
DeployBot: Received command request. Rollout ID rl-2026-04-11-1934. Available safety actions: toggle-ff prompt_route_experimental -> OFF, rollback rollout rl-2026-04-11-1934, scale-down canary pool.
Samir Patel: Quick sanity: does toggling the FF need a coordinated config push? Is this global?
Jia Chen: FF is global and immediate (featureflag service). Toggle is safe and will route to stable-route.
Maria Lopez: Do it. Post the exact command here so we have an audit.
Samir Patel: Command used by SRE console:```bash
# toggle off experimental route
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.local/featureflags/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"prompt_route_experimental","value":false,"operator":"maria.lopez"}'
```
DeployBot: Feature flag toggle initiated by maria.lopez at 10:27:42 UTC. Confirmed propagation to edge caches in ~3s. Traffic for experimental route cut to 0%.
Maria Lopez: Confirming observability: error rate back to baseline for the main route, canary pods still noisy but no customer impact now. Lina please confirm tickets updated / customer-notified.
Lina Gomez: Notified affected customers with status: "We routed traffic away from the experimental path; service should be back to normal. We are investigating." Ticket updates posted.
Jia Chen: I'll port logs + heap dumps from canary nodes for deeper analysis. Looks like the request patterns cause KV cache spikes leading to memory churn.
Ankit Rao: Capture: stack traces reference kv_shard_alloc and a recent change to windowed-eviction in runtime. Could be a regression in the new caching policy.
Samir Patel: Operations: we should also mute the noisy alert to avoid pager fatigue while we investigate. Maria can you ack/mute?
Maria Lopez: Muting alert rule for prompt-route-experimental for 1 hour. Doing that now.
IncidentBot: Alert rule prompt-route-experimental muted by Maria Lopez for 60 minutes.
Maria Lopez: On-call handoff: Samir — I'm handing this to you for post-mortem & rollback consideration. I'll stay in-loop for escalation.
Samir Patel: Taking over. Action items: 1) Collect heap/profile dumps from canary; 2) Reproduce locally with mux config; 3) Patch runtime eviction or revert the caching change; 4) Decide on full rollback vs patched redeploy.
Jia Chen: I'll try to reproduce in staging with the same canary traffic shape.
Lina Gomez: Customer impact summary for SEV board: 3 customers affected, degraded responses 10:22-10:27 UTC, mitigated by FF toggle at 10:27:42 UTC. No data loss.
Ankit Rao: Note: there were 2 pod restarts in canary due to memory OOM, container exit codes 137.
Samir Patel: Next steps: schedule immediate rollback candidate if we see recurrence after unmuting alerts. Also add a temporary capacity limit on KV cache for experimental route to avoid noisy neighbor.
Maria Lopez: Thanks team. I'll create the incident ticket and ping infra for priority access to heap dumps. If anyone sees recurrence post-unmute, page me immediately. :thumbsup:
SupportOps: Tickets updated and incident ticket INC-2026-045 created.
Maria Lopez: Closing live mitigation thread — filed for postmortem. Will assign owner and timeline.
Samir Patel: Acknowledged, will lead postmortem and include timeline, root cause hypothesis, and remediation plan (rollback vs fix + tests).
